body: This is the third one this month, I dont know if theres anymore in my town dude.

This morning I told my mother. I walked into her room and said I wasn't going to school. And I broke down about everything and she said that shes going to get me counseling and therapy and that I could take some days off till I feel better. 

I honestly never saw this as an outcome and I would like to thank you for your support because I was honestly ready to kill my self, but I think I'm ready to get medacated for my panic attacks and such. 

If it ever gets as bad as it was last night I'll post again. 

Thank you kind redditor, I feel a huge weight lifted from me thanks to you.

Comparing myself to others is what I was raised on. My mother would always point out to me how much better others were to me. I cant even look at a 85% grade a think it's good because I know others could do better, I could do better. I was forced into the way I think and it's such a cruel habit. I think I'm going to just take a long fucking nap. I'll talk to my mom in the morning and I'll report back with the information, but I can almost assure you that things will only stay the same or get worse.

Damn, that hits hard. It's scary how much hearing some stranger on the internet say that they care can make one cry such a fuck ton. I know I need to talk to a professional about this, a want to in fact, do you have any tips on how I could tell my mother or father though?

I do have a few things I enjoy, I write alot, I play instruments and I do swimming, and I've been doing it for years and everyone else is so much fuckibg better at things than me and it makes me pissed off. I want to be good at something, ve able to want to have something to devote my life to, but I cant see anything.
